news.headline: Bavarian Nordic names new CEO; Abivax and ProQR add key leaders
JMP Securities raises Abivax price target to $114 from $95
news.summary: JMP Securities (Citizens JMP) raised its Abivax price target to $114 from $95 while maintaining a Market Outperform rating, updating its model for H1 2026 results and the July ADS financing.

news.headline: Truist lowers Abivax price target to $151, keeps Buy rating
news.summary: Truist Securities trimmed its Abivax price target to $151 from $155 while maintaining a Buy rating in the wake of the company's H1 2026 earnings report.

news.headline: Barclays reaffirms Overweight rating on Abivax, $148 target
news.summary: Barclays reiterated its Overweight rating on Abivax with a $148 price target following the company's H1 2026 financial results.

news.headline: Wedbush cuts Abivax price target to $118 on wider H1 loss
news.summary: Wedbush kept its Neutral rating but cut its Abivax price target to $118 from $140, citing a wider-than-expected H1 2026 net loss and rising cash-burn concerns despite revenue beating estimates.

news.headline: Abivax posts H1 2026 results, wider loss, CMO transition announced
news.summary: Abivax reported a wider-than-expected H1 2026 net loss but ended June with cash plus short-term investments of €402.4 million, boosted by €767.1 million in net proceeds from its July ADS offering, giving a runway into Q4 2029; it also announced Chris Rabbat will succeed Fabio Cataldi as Chief Medical Officer and named Tim Kelly Chief Technical Officer, while reaffirming its obefazimod NDA submission remains on track for Q4 2026.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Alongside its H1 2026 results, Abivax detailed the leadership build-out ahead of a potential obefazimod launch, naming Chris Rabbat as Chief Medical Officer and Tim Kelly as Chief Technical Officer to lead CMC, quality and IT as commercial supply readiness ramps up.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Abivax has reaffirmed guidance to submit its first New Drug Application to the FDA by the end of 2026, following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the agency in July 2026.

catalysts.label: EMA marketing authorization filing (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Company guidance calls for filing obefazimod for EMA approval in ulcerative colitis in the second half of 2026, alongside the FDA submission.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease induction data
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction results from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are expected; the company's current pipeline guidance points to mid-2027, a slip from earlier late-2026 outlook language.

pulse: Abivax remains on track to file its first NDA with the FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026, backed by a strengthened cash position (~€1.17 billion combined cash and July offering proceeds) that funds operations into Q4 2029. A wider-than-expected H1 2026 net loss drew mixed analyst reactions -- Wedbush and Truist trimmed price targets while Barclays held its $148 target and JMP Securities raised its target to $114 on September 25 -- and the company is building out its commercial leadership (new CMO and CTO) ahead of a potential 2027 launch. Crohn's disease Phase 2b (ENHANCE-CD) induction data has meanwhile slipped to mid-2027 per the latest pipeline guidance.
